signals.title: USD/NOK — G10 Bilateral Theme + Sanctions Escalation
signals.text: USD outperforms the G10 board while NOK lags following President Trump signing a Russia sanctions bill opening China and India to secondary tariffs alongside heightened Strait of Hormuz tensions. Secondary tariff friction and geopolitical supply-chain disruption accelerate safe-haven capital into the greenback against energy-sensitive European currencies. The upcoming Norges Bank policy meeting on 24 Sep resolves whether rate guidance counteracts ongoing spot erosion above the 20-day SMA of 9.317. Trade bias: Bullish USD/NOK into the weekly open. Catalyst: Sydney open follow-through ahead of Norges Bank meeting on 24 Sep. Risk: Break below Friday close 9.404 toward the 20-day SMA (9.317) on de-escalation headlines.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Crowded Long Positioning Unwind Risk
signals.text: AUD COT LF long +59.3k (74.2% long, 97th percentile, z=+2.11) creates crowded-long unwind risk after AUD/USD closed Friday at 0.7121 below its 20-day SMA (0.7168). A restrictive Fed stance (real policy rate +1.59% vs AUD +0.85%) and secondary tariff threats against China test speculative length despite positive AONIA carry (+50bp). The RBA policy meeting on 29 Sep is the catalyst that determines whether domestic rate support holds spot above the 50-day SMA (0.7087). Trade bias: Bearish AUD/USD into the open. Catalyst: RBA policy decision on 29 Sep. Risk: Sustained recovery above the 20-day SMA (0.7168) driven by extended domestic ESI outperformance (+14.2).

signals.title: EUR/USD — Crowded Net Short vs Multi-Horizon Technical Breakdown
signals.text: EUR COT LF short -51.4k (38.4% long) anchors an entrenched downside bias as EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1490 beneath its 20-day (1.1597), 50-day (1.1540), and 200-day (1.1632) SMAs. SOFR-€STR carry advantage of +141bp and the US bear steepener curve regime (+32.8bp 2s10s) maintain structural capital flow favoring the dollar. Twin speeches by ECB President Lagarde on Monday resolve whether policy commentary offers counter-cyclical resistance against 1.1400. Trade bias: Bearish EUR/USD. Catalyst: ECB President Lagarde address at 11:00 UTC Monday. Risk: Daily close back above the 50-day SMA (1.1540) invalidating the technical breakdown.
evidence: OIS carry: SOFR 3.85% vs ESTR 2.44% (+141bp favoring USD)
